# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 1.0.x   | :white_check_mark: |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Security is the core priority of Krypton Vault. If you discover a security vulnerability or cryptographic weakness, please follow responsible disclosure:

1. **Do not create a public issue or discussion.**
2. Send an advisory report via private GitHub Security Advisory or email the maintainer.
3. Please include:
   - Detailed description of the vulnerability.
   - Steps to reproduce or proof-of-concept.
   - Impact assessment (e.g., local storage, memory, peer-to-peer sync).

We take all vulnerability reports seriously and will acknowledge receipt and work on a remediation promptly.
